kaaba.definition: n. (Islam) a black stone building in Mecca that is shaped like a cube and that is the most sacred Muslim pilgrim shrine; believed to have been given by Gabriel to Abraham; Muslims turn in its direction when praying
kaaba.translation: n. 天房(麦加城中的方形石殿)

kaas.translation: (kaa 的复数) abbr. keep-alive anode 永正极

kaavie.translation: [气]卡维雪, 苏格兰的大 雪
